scope: Independent critic review, four separate F-to-A grades, B+ minimum in every category, actionable builder feedback and an enforced release gate.

intuitiveness.evidence: The documented cycle, durable report schema, one PowerShell command and per-feature HOLD diagnostics clearly explain the developer journey. The independent wrapper run compiled the Pascal tooling, passed its 24 tests, and explicitly reported all four actual pending features.

accuracy.evidence: Grade floors, recorded critic/builder distinction, incomplete and rejected reviews, changed scope and stale-file fingerprints work in the supplied fixtures. Independent Pascal probing found that reviews/../build/temporary.json and reviews/..\build/temporary.json are accepted report paths on Windows, violating the durable reviews/ confinement contract.

wowFactor.evidence: Evaluated proportionately as developer tooling: actual feedback is concise and the gate prevents premature acceptance while retaining useful build evidence. Static CI inspection confirms Pages configure/upload require the critic step outcome and deployment depends on both build and critic-gate. No hosted CI execution or product audio/visual quality is claimed.

thinkingOutOfTheBox.evidence: Separate build evidence and acceptance jobs, per-category thresholds, and LF-normalized reviewed-file fingerprints combine into a practical revision workflow without replacing independent judgment. The documentation explicitly states identity authentication and omitted-scope limitations.

blockingFindings: Reject noncanonical report pointers and confine the resolved path to reviews/. Add regressions for both slash and Windows-backslash traversal into build/, then rerun the independent probe.
